$description: The portable token layer. ui.css is the implementation; this file is the contract. Every value carries where it came from, because the last time that was implicit the code drifted from Paper by four colours without anything failing. Checked by scripts/check-tokens.mjs.

grey-100.note: one step under grey-50, for sunk surfaces

grey-200.note: a rule that has to be seen rather than felt

grey-400.note: text that is present but not being read

grey-600.note: hover lift for ink fills — a ~20 L* step, matching #000 → #333

blue-200.note: the active-tool disc, measured off brand/reference/navbar.png

red-400.note: the lit shoulder of the flat mark

paper.role: The ground every surface sits on.

paper-soft.role: A surface that is behind, not under — meta rows, expanded regions.

rule-strong.role: A border that has to be read, not just felt.

ink-faint.role: Present but not being read: placeholders, struck-out values.

ink.role: Primary text, and the fill of anything that will act.

ink-lift.role: Hover for ink-filled surfaces. Sized to the step #000 → #333 gives on Vercel, so the change reads without being looked for.

off.role: The fill of a control that is switched off or disabled.

off-hover.role: One step down from off, so hovering a switched-off control acknowledges the pointer.

sky-fill.role: Switched on: the active tool's disc and the count badge. Not selection — a selected pin deepens its own grey instead, so blue keeps one meaning.

cobalt.role: The glyph or numeral inside a switched-on fill.

measure.role: Measurement: the outline around what you are about to pin, the hairline around what you already pinned. Same primitive as ink-muted on purpose — it is one decision, and the alias is what records that.

measure-wash.role: The fill inside a picker outline.

measure-glow.role: The ring around a selected pin. A lighter weight of the same grey the card already wears as a hairline, so selection reads as a halo rather than a second border — over white it resolves to about #dcdddf.

red.role: The mark. Edge anchors, wire endpoints, delete.

red-tint.role: The disc behind a destructive glyph.

$notInTheRamp.$why: Status colours have to be recognisable before they are on-palette. Amber is the offline/blocked banner. Green went unused when the status dot left the shelf row — status now reads as a labelled row in the inspector, which needs no colour.

$knownGaps: sky / sky-tint / sky-fill / cobalt are still named for appearance rather than role. What they mean is focus-ring, wash, on-fill, on-glyph. Renaming them touches every component, so it is deliberately deferred rather than half-done.
Spacing, radius, and type are not tokenised as a ramp — radius has three values, spacing is written inline. Only colour has a real two-layer model so far.
Nothing checks contrast. sky-fill against cobalt and ink against paper are assumed to pass, not measured.
The dark scheme reassigns semantics by hand rather than deriving them, so a new primitive does not automatically get a dark counterpart.
